mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (measured as a 3-month decrease) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in declining rate periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 40% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) combined with falling housing starts (HOUST) signals a deteriorating labor market and weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 40% of instances where UNRATE rises and HOUST falls, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (indicated by strong GDP growth and low unemployment), profit margins compress due to high input costs, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 40% of late-cycle expansion periods, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 indicates a manufacturing slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 40% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (measured as a 3-month rise) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in rising unemployment periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) are rising and housing starts (HOUST) are falling, it signals a shift from durable to non-durable consumption, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 40% of instances where RSAFS rises and HOUST falls, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5% year-over-year, it signals persistent inflation that triggers central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 40% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
